module: Entry point of the "Console" Lua VM (used for command-line tools, outside the game). It sets package.path/cpath, loads extensions (paths lua/ge/extensions/ and lua/common/extensions/), then luaCore, common/cdefs, utils and mathlib. It defines no function.
notes: Defines the global Engine as a fake object: Engine.Profiler.pushEvent and popEvent are nops, so that shared code that calls the profiler works in the console.
package.cpath is emptied: no native library can be loaded from this VM.
